Pinned upstream sources (MIT OR Apache-2.0; licenses are retained per crate):
  iroh 1.4.1: https://github.com/n0-computer/iroh
  noq-proto 1.4.0: https://github.com/n0-computer/noq
  netwatch 0.19.3: https://github.com/n0-computer/net-tools

Nautilo changes:
  noq-proto/src/config/transport.rs: optional per-path STREAM payload filter.
  noq-proto/src/connection/mod.rs: gate STREAM scheduling, packet creation,
    retransmission and receive; control/handshake/NAT/DATAGRAM frames remain live.
  iroh/src/endpoint/quic.rs: direct_streams_only uses iroh's actual IP/mapped
    transport classification, including fail-closed handling of mixed addresses.
  iroh/src/net_report.rs: retain the first QAD observation for each live IPv4/
    IPv6 discovery connection, so periodic reports reuse the known mapping
    instead of dropping it while waiting for an address change.
  noq-proto/src/n0_nat_traversal.rs + connection/mod.rs: read-only peer candidate
    diagnostics on both QUIC sides (server REACH_OUT, client ADD_ADDRESS).
  iroh/src/endpoint/connection.rs: expose those candidates under unstable-net-report.
  iroh/src/socket/stun.rs + socket/transports: bounded RFC 5389 Binding probes
    share the exact QUIC socket and normal receive loop. Validate transaction ID,
    response source, framing and XOR-MAPPED-ADDRESS; never compete for UDP reads.
  iroh/src/endpoint.rs: explicit probe_stun API; applications own refresh/expiry
    and must verify an actual QUIC IP path before describing a connection as direct.

Only the patches and pinned checksums are tracked in rust/patches.
Android's netwatch socket patch retains an explicit Network binding across UDP
socket recovery. Iroh exposes this for its UDP sockets only; TCP/HTTP and
process-wide routing remain unchanged. OS binding failures are returned.
scripts/prepare-rust-sources.mjs downloads the official crates, verifies SHA-256,
applies the patches and verifies the complete patched source tree. Generated
sources and archives live in rust/vendor/generated and are excluded from Git.
Desktop development, packaging/CI and Android builds prepare them automatically.
Before running cargo directly, run: node scripts/prepare-rust-sources.mjs
After the first download, --offline can rebuild from the verified archive cache.

The source is patched in rust/Cargo.toml and apps/mobile/native/iroh-kmp/Cargo.toml.
Keep the two dependency versions pinned together when upgrading.

Protocol: Nautilo business traffic is confined to bidirectional STREAMs.
DATAGRAM accepts only a bounded transport-policy nonce request and fixed metadata;
it never accepts an RPC method, user message, file, or workspace content.

Validation: nautilo-core runtime::remote::direct_tests covers relay-only control
with zero transmitted/received STREAM frames, rejection of legacy relay payloads,
relay-assisted IP candidate exchange, and blocked-path queue/recovery behavior.
These controlled local transport tests do not claim a physical two-network NAT test.
The QAD regression test keeps an established discovery connection alive while
dropping new QUIC Initials, then verifies the mapping survives the 20-26s recheck.
